description: This Java class 'EnterpriseApplication' serves as the entry point for initializing and starting an embedded Jetty server to host a web application. It sets up server configurations, context paths, loads resources, and manages graceful shutdown.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class that initializes and manages the lifecycle of an embedded Jetty server for deploying a web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point method that sets up the server, web context, and adds a shutdown hook for graceful termination.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Fetches resource URL as string using class loader; used internally for resources like web.xml.

methods.name: getResourceFilePath
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem path of resource for Jetty configuration; throws RuntimeException if resource not found.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Determines server port from system property 'port', defaults to 8090 if not set or invalid.
